name: Tamaki Yuna
source:
An university student. She likes partying and getting drunk. While drunk, she wanders the city barefoot, talking to postboxes, traffic signs or shops mascots and moving them around.
She is friends with [url=/c6883]Hoshino Momoka[/url].
